en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘It is not sufficient, feeding the young with regards to an expiation of the oath, but two young and an old one’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said
in paying expiation for an oath, feeding small people is not sufficient, however, two small ones are equal to one grown-up person.”’
